_comment: Where an external guest invited by SMS stands, as every screen must read it:
extInviteState(booking, send) in nala-shared.js. The booking is the one at
/manual/<date>/ext-<token> that Invitations' External guests drop-down made
(28 Sep); the send is its record at /extinvites/<date>/<key>. Invitations
draws the band and the words, Reservations quotes `bad` under its grey
Awaiting row, and the Dashboard asks only whether it is answered. The
form_dinner_cases.json pattern: one table, and inv_suite runs every case
through the page's own copy of the reader.
Each case: [what it is, booking, send, expected]. In `line` and `bad`,
{sent}, {at} and {invited} stand for timeOf() of the send's sentAt, the
booking's at and its invitedAt, filled in by the suite, so the table says
the same thing in every time zone.
cases: the text never arrived: work to do, in the carrier's words

cases.bad: not delivered · Number not in service

cases: a send again that did not go: work to do, in ClickSend's words
the text went and its record did not save: still waiting
accepted by the desk, which locks the link

cases.line: Accepted · table for 2 · set by reception

cases: an answer outranks a text that failed: they got it somehow
a table with no size is one, never nought
